readme:
# Fotocasa Scraper

Get property listings from [Fotocasa](https://www.fotocasa.es/), the Spanish property portal. Give the actor a list page address or a city name, choose buy or rent, and it returns one record per listing: price, price drop, rooms, bathrooms, surface, address, coordinates, features, images, dates and the agency behind the ad. No login and no API key are needed.

## What you get

- One record per listing from Fotocasa list pages, about 30 listings per page.
- Sale and rent lists. Pass a list page address, or a city slug with the operation.
- Several pages in one run. Set `maxItems` and the actor reads as many pages as it needs.
- Each listing once per run, even if it shows up on more than one page.
- A run that is interrupted continues where it stopped. Listings already delivered are not delivered or charged again.
- You pay only for listings that were saved to the dataset.

## Use with AI agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client, such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain or LlamaIndex.

**MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/fotocasa-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `fotocasa-scraper` to list 60 flats for sale in Madrid with price, rooms, surface and agency, as a CSV."

## Data extracted

| Field | Example |
|-------|---------|
| `id` | `"191064926"` |
| `url` | Link to the listing page |
| `operation` | `"buy"` or `"rent"` |
| `property_type`, `property_subtype` | `"Flat"`, `"Attic"` |
| `price` | `349900` |
| `price_text` | `"349.900 €"` |
| `currency` | `"EUR"` |
| `price_period` | `"month"` for monthly rents |
| `price_drop`, `old_price` | Reduction shown on the card and the price before it |
| `rooms`, `bathrooms` | `2`, `1` |
| `surface_m2` | `80` |
| `floor_code` | Site code for the floor |
| `attribute_codes` | Site codes for conservation status, orientation, antiquity and hot water |
| `features` | `["heating", "terrace", "elevator"]` |
| `highlights` | Highlight tags such as `IS_EXTERIOR` |
| `location`, `neighborhood`, `district`, `city`, `province`, `region`, `zip_code`, `country` | Address parts |
| `latitude`, `longitude` | Coordinates |
| `description` | Text written by the advertiser |
| `images`, `image_count` | Image links and their number |
| `other_media` | Videos, virtual tours and floor plans |
| `published_at`, `updated_at` | Dates in UTC |
| `is_new_construction`, `is_promotion`, `is_highlighted`, `is_top`, `is_opportunity`, `is_bare_ownership`, `is_occupied`, `is_auctioned`, `is_rented_with_tenants`, `is_temporary_rental` | Flags shown by the site |
| `promotion_title`, `promotion_url` | New development name and link, when the listing belongs to one |
| `advertiser_type` | `"professional"` or `"private"` |
| `agency_name`, `agency_id`, `agency_url`, `agency_logo`, `agency_phone` | Agency details, for professional advertisers only |
| `source_url`, `page`, `scraped_at` | Where and when the row was read |

Fields that a page does not show are returned empty. For private advertisers the actor returns only `advertiser_type`; their name, link and phone number are not copied.

## Pricing

Pay-per-event pricing. You pay only for listings that were saved to the dataset.

| Event | Price |
|-------|-------|
| Actor start (`actor-start`) | $0.001 |
| Listing scraped (`listing-result`) | $0.001 per listing ($1.00 per 1,000) |

The start event is charged once per run, together with the first saved listing. A run that returns nothing is not charged. If you set a maximum cost per run, the actor stops before it goes over that limit.

## Input

| Field | Type | Description | Default |
|-------|------|-------------|---------|
| `startUrls` | string[] | Fotocasa list pages, for example `https://www.fotocasa.es/es/comprar/viviendas/madrid-capital/todas-las-zonas/l`. Filters that are part of the address are kept. | none |
| `locations` | string[] | City slugs such as `madrid-capital` or `barcelona-capital`. Used with `operation` and `propertyType`. | none |
| `operation` | string | `buy` or `rent`, for `locations`. | `buy` |
| `propertyType` | string | `viviendas` (homes), `locales`, `oficinas`, `garajes` or `terrenos`, for `locations`. | `viviendas` |
| `maxItems` | integer | Most listings to return across all inputs. 0 uses 100. | `100` |

At least one of `startUrls` or `locations` is required.

## Usage examples

### Flats for sale in Madrid

```json
{
  "locations": ["madrid-capital"],
  "operation": "buy",
  "maxItems": 60
}
```

### Rentals in two cities

```json
{
  "locations": ["barcelona-capital", "valencia-capital"],
  "operation": "rent",
  "maxItems": 200
}
```

### A list page you copied from the site

```json
{
  "startUrls": ["https://www.fotocasa.es/es/alquiler/viviendas/barcelona-capital/todas-las-zonas/l"],
  "maxItems": 100
}
```

## Output

Results are saved to the default dataset. Export them as JSON, CSV or Excel, or read them through the API.

  "rooms": 2,

  "features": ["heating", "terrace", "elevator", "balcony"],
  "location": "Calle de Benidorm, Ventas",

(The sample is shortened. Real rows also hold the description, image links and the other fields listed above.)

## Limitations

- Only list pages are read. The actor does not open single listing pages, so details that appear only there are not included.
- Floor, conservation status, orientation, antiquity and hot water come as site codes, not as text. The actor does not translate them.
- `price_drop` is the reduction the card shows; `old_price` is calculated as price plus that reduction.
- The site may limit how deep a long list goes. If a list ends early, the run ends with the listings it found.
- Only the home list type (`viviendas`) has been tested in depth. Other property types use the same address pattern.
- Descriptions are copied as the advertiser wrote them.
- Fotocasa terms limit commercial reuse of its content and images. You are responsible for how you use the data.

## FAQ

**How do I find the city slug?**
Open a list page on fotocasa.es and look at the address. In `.../comprar/viviendas/madrid-capital/todas-las-zonas/l` the slug is `madrid-capital`.

**Can I use filters such as price or rooms?**
Set them on the site, copy the list address and use it as a start URL. Filters that are part of the address are kept on every page.

**Why is a field empty?**
The card did not show it. Phone numbers, for example, are missing on some ads.

**Do I get private sellers?**
Yes, as rows with `advertiser_type` set to `private`. Their name, link and phone number are not returned.

**What happens when I set a maximum cost?**
The actor stops before the limit and the run status says so.

**What does a run cost?**
One start event plus one result event per listing saved. See the pricing table above.
